entries.evidence: The file defines the submodel Axle-with-Gears (a 6L axle with a 14 tooth bevel gear and an 8 tooth gear) but never places it; step 20 (scan 011) places it (docs/audits/for-erik.md, Model-file findings, high as a fact, medium for the line). The audit's line, `1 0 0 10 -60 -1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 -1 8838 - Axle-with-Gears.ldr` in "8838 - Shock Cycle.ldr", put into the main model's coordinates (it places Shock Cycle turned): worked out, not yet seen in place.
